start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-g.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=UTC APP_ENV=dev && rm -f eval-g.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-g-server.log 2>&1
start_note: Backend :8000 and frontend Vite :5173 (Vite proxies /api to 127.0.0.1:8000). Setup as in group F (sqlite3 admin insert with argon2 hash, POST /api/admin/doctors, register patients, book via POST /api/appointments). Cancel-window checks (60:00 / 59:59 / 10 min) are arranged by sqlite3 UPDATE of slots.start_time/end_time for the target appointment; refund stub call count is not HTTP-observable and is verified via the pytest spy tests in backend/tests/integration/test_cancel.py. Seed check (E6-S1) uses a separate DB file: DATABASE_PATH=./eval-g-seed.db, alembic upgrade head, then uv run python scripts/seed.py twice.

api_checks.note: setup/regression: GET /health 200; admin login; onboard doctors A and B; register patients P1..P3; book slots to create BOOKED appointments. Failure blocks the group.

patient books a slot; sqlite3 move its start_time so start - now is just over 60:00 (document slack); cancel. Verify appointment CANCELLED, slot AVAILABLE, exactly one CANCELLED event with actor_role PATIENT. Exact 60:00 boundary and refund spy count == 1 verified by pytest test_cancel.py (injected clock). Also verify the doctor-visible event list/DB has no second CANCELLED event.
start_time at now+59m, and another already started: cancel -> 409 CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED; appointment stays BOOKED, slot BOOKED, no new event; refund spy 0 (pytest).
P2 cancels P1's appointment -> 404; nothing changed.

doctor A cancels a BOOKED appointment starting in 10 minutes -> 200; appointment CANCELLED, slot BLOCKED, one CANCELLED event actor_role DOCTOR; refund spy count 1 (pytest). Doctor B -> 404; admin -> 403.
appointments set via sqlite3 to CHECKED_IN, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW: cancel as patient and as doctor -> 409 INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE; event count unchanged for each.
no token -> 401; unknown appointment id as an owner role -> 404.
returns all users with role and active; ?role=DOCTOR only doctors; ?role=BAD -> 422; patient token -> 403. Each item carries role and active; deactivated users still listed with active=false.

deactivate patient P1 (has BOOKED appointment) -> 200 active=false; P1 login -> 401; P1's old token on GET /api/auth/me -> 401; appointment row still exists and doctor A can still transition it (check-in) -> 200.

doctor with BOOKED -> 409 ACTIVE_APPOINTMENTS_EXIST and still active; repeat with a doctor whose appointment is CHECKED_IN and another IN_PROGRESS (sqlite3) -> 409 each; doctor with only terminal appointments -> 200 and absent from GET /api/doctors.
admin deactivates own user_id -> 409 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF; sqlite3 confirms active=1.
reactivate P1 -> 200 active=true; P1 login succeeds; reactivated doctor reappears in GET /api/doctors; unknown id -> 404.

PUT with changed full_name/age/gender/phone -> 200 PatientProfile; sqlite3: profile version rows +1, earlier rows unchanged, changed_by_user_id = admin. Non-patient id -> 404; patient token -> 403; invalid field -> 422.

on a fresh DB run cd backend && uv run python scripts/seed.py twice. After run 1: 1 admin, >=3 doctors with distinct specialties, >=5 patients (F121). After run 2: user and slot counts identical (F122). All seeded emails end @example.test; all slots within the next 14 days (F123). Also run pytest backend/tests/integration/test_seed.py. Seeded admin can log in.
api_checks.expect_status: exit 0 on both runs; counts as stated

api_checks.note: patient cancels an appointment whose start_time is already in the past -> 409 CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED; status unchanged, no event (split from G-API-2 so both AC2 branches are asserted separately).

steps: log in as a registered/seeded patient (redirects to /doctors)
F099: search page shows specialty, language, date-range filters and a sort control; cards list fee such as '500.00'; a filter matching nothing shows the empty state
F099: choosing a specialty filter and a language filter narrows the cards to matching doctors; changing the sort control reorders the cards; the date-range filter is operable
F100: open a doctor card; detail page shows open slots for the next 14 days grouped by date, times in browser-local zone with abbreviation (e.g. '10:30 IST' or 'UTC')
F101: select a slot and confirm; confirmation shows doctor, local time and fee
F102: book the same slot via API as another patient first, then confirm in UI; inline 409 message appears and slot list refreshes without the taken slot
F103 (desktop): no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) on search, detail, confirmation
repeat the full G-PW-1280 flow (search, filters, sort, detail, slot pick, confirm, 409 inline refresh) at 375px
F103: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth on search, detail and confirmation pages (no horizontal scroll)
F103: every visible interactive control (button, a, input, select, slot buttons, filters, sort) has bounding box >= 44x44 CSS px; list any offender with selector and size

content_rules: E3-S3: cancel route guarded by require_roles(PATIENT, DOCTOR); admin 403; non-owner 404

E3-S3: patient window check is >= 60:00 against an injected clock; status update, slot release (AVAILABLE for patient, BLOCKED for doctor) and CANCELLED event with actor_role occur in one transaction; refund called once after commit through the overridable PaymentService dependency and never on refusal
E3-S3: CHANGE_WINDOW_CLOSED and INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE map to 409; no SQL in the router
E4-S2: self-deactivation and active-appointment checks live in user_admin_service; auth dependency rejects inactive users on every request (existing tokens 401); admin routes require ADMIN
E4-S2: admin profile PUT inserts a new profile version (append-only, earlier rows never UPDATEd) with changed_by_user_id

E5-S2: frontend calls the API only via src/api/*.ts clients and hooks; fee rendered as the API string (no parseFloat/toFixed on money); slot times formatted with Intl.DateTimeFormat in browser-local zone with short timeZoneName
E5-S2: routes.tsx replaces the ResourceShell placeholder for /doctors and /doctors/:doctor_id with the new pages; 409 handling refetches slots and shows an inline message (no alert, no console.log)
E5-S2: patient controls sized >= 44px (min-h-11/min-w-11 or equivalent), mobile-first layout
E6-S1: seed idempotent (existence checks on email), slots created through the slot generator service, all emails @example.test, no real secrets, layered via seed_service

review_notes: Proposed by generator (lean); pending evaluator review. Derived from stories E3-S3, E4-S2, E5-S2, E6-S1, api-contracts API-09..11, 17..20, 24 and features.json.
Story AC5 names InvalidAppointmentStateException; the API contract error code is INVALID_APPOINTMENT_STATE (API-24).
Exact 60:00 / 59:59 boundary is timing-sensitive over HTTP; rely on the clock-injected pytest test for the boundary and use sqlite3 margins live.
Booking confirmation route path is not fixed in the spec; follow in-app navigation rather than a hardcoded URL.
Out of scope: reschedule (E3-S4), my-appointments (E4-S3), doctor-side UI.

Evaluator review: added G-API-14 (past-start cancel), CHECKED_IN/IN_PROGRESS doctor deactivation in G-API-9, functional filter/sort step in G-PW-1280. All other checks trace to ACs or api-contracts API-17..20, 24; none removed.
